D9_NE_D2.BASELINE: D9: year x sign(D) x RV_5M-bucket rate-matched non-event 5m bars. D2: year x SIDE matched random abstention on daily RULE_1 / RV_ABSTENTION.
D9_NE_D2.INFORMATION_SOURCE_FUNCTION: D9 is two-venue 5m dislocation-resolution attribution (family H / VENUE_STRUCTURE). D2 is daily conditional abstention / tail-risk filtering (family A).
D9_NE_D2.NULL_ELIMINATES: D9 null deprioritizes this pair as a price-discovery mechanism. It does not reopen D2 RV_ABSTENTION, which remains PROMISING_PROTOTYPE / independently replicated.
D9_NE_D2.SELECTOR_OR_EVENT: D9: |D| > trailing 5m P90 over 8640 bars. D2: 24h RV > trailing P90 over 250 daily observations after RULE_1.
D9_NE_D2.TARGET_FAMILY: D9: 1h RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE. D2: filtered vs matched-random adverse-path MAE / ADVERSE_SHARE.

D9_NE_D7.BASELINE: D9 matches non-event bars within year x sign(D) x RV_5M bucket. D7 matches random state within year x RV_BUCKET on CORE hourly IMPACT_PROXY.
D9_NE_D7.INFORMATION_SOURCE_FUNCTION: D9 is cross-venue 5m resolution structure on MARKET_06_OKX_BINANCE_FEASIBILITY_V0. D7 is same-venue CORE BTC 1h kline-derived impact-state persistence (family E).
D9_NE_D7.NULL_ELIMINATES: D9 null does not close kline impact-state persistence. D7 positive does not authorize a D9-like neighbor and does not authorize another family-E card.
D9_NE_D7.SELECTOR_OR_EVENT: D9: two-venue |D| P90. D7: IMPACT_PROXY > trailing P90 over 720 hours. No shared proxy, window, or clock.

D9_NE_MARKET_06.BASELINE: D9: year x sign x RV-bucket rate-matched non-event resolution imbalance. MARKET-06: daily own-state plus additive ABS_DISLOCATION_Z vs 24h direction-aligned MAE.
D9_NE_MARKET_06.INFORMATION_SOURCE_FUNCTION: Same two-venue 5m surface and D(u)=ln(perp/spot) definition. Different FUNCTION (who closes vs incremental BTC-path prediction), different CLOCK (5m event vs daily 00:05), different TARGET (RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE vs 24h MAE).
D9_NE_MARKET_06.NULL_ELIMINATES: D9 null does not reopen MARKET-06_NO_EVIDENCE. MARKET-06 remains consumed. A D9 positive is not MARKET-06 salvage.
D9_NE_MARKET_06.SELECTOR_OR_EVENT: D9 has no additive linear term, no 24h MAE, no daily 00:05 decision, and does not use ABS_DISLOCATION_Z as a BTC-path predictor.
D9_NE_MARKET_06.TARGET_FAMILY: D9 venue-resolution imbalance. MARKET-06 relative MAE improvement.

H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.DATA_REQUIREMENT: Aligned Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perp 5m trade-price closes and OKX BTC-USDT spot 5m trade-price closes already bound as MARKET_06_OKX_BINANCE_FEASIBILITY_V0.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.FUNCTION: Characterize which venue's subsequent return closes an unusually large signed dislocation. Venue-relationship / price-discovery attribution. NOT BTC terminal-return prediction. NOT 24h MAE. NOT additive incremental regression.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: MARKET-06 used daily 00:05 ABS_DISLOCATION_Z as an additive predictor of Binance-perp 24h direction-aligned MAE and returned MARKET_06_NO_EVIDENCE. That confirmatory cell is consumed. D2 used dislocation only as a RULE_2 abstention filter and it failed the discovery gate. Neither studied which venue closes a 5m dislocation.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: Reuse the existing MARKET-06 aligned 5m loader plus one event/resolution evaluator. No new dataset. No third venue. No L2. No execution simulator.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.MECHANISM_CLASS: Price-discovery / dislocation-resolution structure on the existing two-venue BTC surface.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.RESEARCHER_DOF: LOW. One trailing P90 |D| event, one 8640-bar window reused from MARKET-06's already-frozen dislocation reference length, one 12-bar horizon, one imbalance functional, one year×sign×RV-bucket non-event baseline.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.SIMPLE_BASELINE_OR_NULL: YEAR_SIGN_RV_MATCHED_RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_NON_EVENT: same calendar year, same sign(D), same trailing RV_5M bucket, not a P90 |D| event, rate-matched without replacement. Tests whether extreme disagreements have a different venue-resolution imbalance than ordinary disagreements after matching sign and contemporaneous perp volatility.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.TARGET_FAMILY: Signed 1h resolution imbalance: Binance-perp gap-closing move minus OKX-spot gap-closing move after an extreme 5m dislocation.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.TIME_SCALE: Native 5m event time plus a frozen 12-bar (1h) resolution horizon.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One non-overlapping extreme-dislocation 5m bar on the aligned two-venue clock.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Using this Binance-perp vs OKX-spot pair as a price-discovery / venue-leadership mechanism at extreme 5m dislocations, beyond ordinary same-sign disagreements matched on year and perp RV.
H1_VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTUR.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Eligibility to propose a later confirmatory venue-structure / price-discovery study, or to justify adding a third venue. Does NOT create MARKET-07, reopen MARKET-06 MAE, or authorize 2025/2026.

H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.FUNCTION: Lead-lag / shock transmission: after an extreme own-venue 5m return, measure the other venue's subsequent follow-through.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.INFORMATION_SOURCE: MARKET_06_OKX_BINANCE_FEASIBILITY_V0, same snapshot and window as H1.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: D4 LEAD_LAG_1DAY was deferred because an independent-block null destroyed ordinary same-time common-factor dependence. Two highly correlated BTC prices share a dominant common factor at 5m.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: One shock constructor plus one lag evaluator on the existing two-leg loader.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.MECHANISM_CLASS: Venue-specific shock transmission / short-horizon lead-lag on the two-venue BTC surface.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.RESEARCHER_DOF: MEDIUM-HIGH. Shock definition, which-venue-first, lag length, and especially the common-factor-preserving null are all residual researcher choices. D4 already showed this null class is fragile.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.SELECTION_REJECT_REASON: Expected information gain is dominated by a hard common-factor null, the same class that deferred D4. Not selected.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.SIMPLE_BASELINE_OR_NULL: A common-factor-preserving null (time-of-day / contemporaneous-move matched). Independent reshuffling is not admissible because it destroys ordinary co-movement.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.TARGET_FAMILY: Other-venue follow-through after an extreme own-venue 5m return.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.TIME_SCALE: Native 5m plus a short lag of a few bars.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Short-horizon lead-lag / shock-transmission claims on this two-venue BTC pair, if the null is actually defensible.
H2_CROSS_VENUE_SHOCK_TRANSMISSION.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: A later confirmation of venue-specific transmission, only after the common-factor null is shown to be adequate.

H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.FUNCTION: Characterize the signed dislocation process itself (decay / persistence of D), not which venue moved and not BTC path risk.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.INFORMATION_SOURCE: MARKET_06_OKX_BINANCE_FEASIBILITY_V0, same snapshot and window as H1.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: MARKET-06 used the level of daily ABS_DISLOCATION_Z to predict 24h BTC MAE. It did not test whether D mean-reverts, or how fast. Two quotes of the same BTC are expected to be tightly bound, so simple mean reversion of D is close to a mechanical tautology.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: One dislocation-process evaluator on the existing two-leg loader. No new dataset.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.MECHANISM_CLASS: Dynamics of the two-venue dislocation process (spread-like D), not price-discovery attribution and not BTC MAE.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.RESEARCHER_DOF: MEDIUM. Choice of decay functional, horizon, and whether a random-walk / OU null is interesting enough to be worth a card.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.SELECTION_REJECT_REASON: A null would mostly restate that two BTC prices do not permanently diverge. Lower information gain than H1's who-closes question. Not selected.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.SIMPLE_BASELINE_OR_NULL: Vol-matched random-walk or simple signed-decay null on D. Ordinary bars vs extreme bars optional.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.TARGET_FAMILY: Decay / persistence of |D| or signed D over a short horizon.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.TIME_SCALE: Native 5m dislocation path over a short frozen horizon.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One aligned 5m dislocation observation, possibly event-triggered.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Treating simple mean reversion of this two-venue dislocation as a research-worthy venue-structure mechanism.
H3_DISLOCATION_PROCESS_DYNAMICS.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Only a surprisingly non-mechanical decay structure would justify later confirmation; that bar is poorly identified a priori.

D9.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_TARGET: TOTAL_CLOSURE and 6-bar (30m) RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE. Cannot change classification. Cannot rescue the 12-bar primary.
FEASIBILITY_CENSUS_ALLOWED_BEFORE_OUTCOM: |D| distribution summaries that are not RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE
FEASIBILITY_MUST_NOT_INSPECT: TOTAL_CLOSURE as an outcome used to choose thresholds
FORBIDDEN_MARKET06_RESCUE: additive incremental regression beside BTC controls

FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.D_U: ln(perp_close(u) / spot_close(u)) at aligned 5m bar-end u. Both closes finite and strictly positive, else missing.
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.EVENT: |D(u)| > P90(previous 8640 valid |D|), current u excluded, strict >
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.INELIGIBLE_IF: D(u) missing/nonfinite; any required close on [u, u+12 bars] missing/nonfinite; RV_5M bucket undefined; resolution end not strictly before 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z. No epsilon repair.
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.OVERLAP_RULE: Keep the first qualifying event; drop later candidates whose event bar is within 12 bars of a kept event.
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.RV_BUCKETS: 4 trailing quantile buckets of previous 8640 valid RV_5M observations, current u excluded, cuts at P25/P50/P75
FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION.TRAILING_WINDOW_NOTE: 8640*5m = 30 days; length reused from MARKET-06 dislocation reference set so this card does not search a new lookback.

D9.FUNCTION: Venue-relationship / price-discovery attribution. NOT terminal-return prediction. NOT directional alpha. NOT MARKET-06 MAE rescue. NOT D2 abstention. NOT D7 kline-impact persistence.
D9.INFORMATION_SOURCE: MARKET_06_OKX_BINANCE_FEASIBILITY_V0 only. Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perp 5m trade-price klines + OKX BTC-USDT spot 5m trade-price klines. No L2, no third venue, no CORE_BTC 1m substitution, no 2025/2026.
D9.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: MARKET-06 consumed the confirmatory claim that daily ABS_DISLOCATION_Z adds 24h MAE information; RESULT MARKET_06_NO_EVIDENCE. D2 RULE_2 used dislocation as an abstention filter and failed its discovery gate. D7 used CORE BTC 1h kline impact-state persistence on a different family and dataset. This card reuses the two-venue 5m surface and the D(u)=ln(perp/spot) definition, but changes FUNCTION, TARGET, UNIT, and CLOCK.
D9.LEGAL_INTERVAL: Aligned 5m bars with open in [2022-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z). Resolution end must satisfy u+1h < 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z. Protected 2025/2026 sealed. No equality-at-boundary relaxation.
D9.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect. A systematic venue-leader at extreme dislocations would at most motivate a later confirmatory price-discovery study or a third venue. It is not a tradable basis strategy, not order-book liquidity, and not a MARKET-06 MAE salvage.
D9.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: Reuse existing MARKET-06 aligned 5m loader plus one event/resolution evaluator. No new dataset. No third venue. No L2 ingestion. No execution simulator. No object-storage durability work in the D9 implementation unit.
D9.MECHANISM_CLASS: Price-discovery / dislocation-resolution structure between Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perp and OKX BTC-USDT spot.
D9.NAME: VENUE_DISLOCATION_RESOLUTION_STRUCTURE
D9.PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION: RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE = PERP_LEG_CLOSURE - SPOT_LEG_CLOSURE over the frozen 12-bar horizon, with PERP_LEG_CLOSURE = -sign(D(u))*ln(perp_close(u+1h)/perp_close(u)) and SPOT_LEG_CLOSURE = sign(D(u))*ln(spot_close(u+1h)/spot_close(u)). Positive means Binance perp contributed more gap-closing move than OKX spot.
PROMISING_PROTOTYPE_REQUIREMENTS: meaningful practical magnitude versus year x sign(D) x RV_BUCKET rate-matched non-event bars
effect not isolated to one year
adequate event and control support under the frozen support rule
no obvious mechanical 'perp is noisier' explanation after RV-bucket matching
no hidden threshold, lookback, or horizon search
no 24h MAE or MARKET-06 additive-model reuse
D9.RESEARCHER_DOF: LOW. One frozen P90 |D| event, one 8640-bar window, one 12-bar horizon, one imbalance target, one year×sign×RV-bucket non-event baseline. Residual risk is still using a two-leg surface that MARKET-06 already touched, even though the claim is different.
D9.SIMPLE_BASELINE: YEAR_SIGN_RV_MATCHED_RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_NON_EVENT. A control bar must be in the same calendar year, have the same sign(D), fall in the same trailing RV_5M bucket, and FAIL the event rule |D(u)| <= trailing P90. Rate-matched without replacement. Do not weaken P90 to obtain more events or controls. If controls are insufficient: DEFERRED_INSUFFICIENT_CONTROL_SUPPORT, not a broader pool and not a weaker threshold.
D9.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Exactly one event definition (|D| > trailing P90, 8640 bars). Exactly one primary horizon (12 bars / 1h). 6-bar imbalance is diagnostic only. Exactly one primary target (RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE). Exactly one primary control (YEAR_SIGN_RV_MATCHED_RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_NON_EVENT). No P80/P95. No 24h MAE. No additive regression. No D(u) z-score predictor of BTC path.

STRUCTURAL_SUPPORT_FROM_EXISTING_CENSUS.NOTE: Existing MARKET-06 timestamp census only. This unit does not compute |D|, events, or RESOLUTION_IMBALANCE.

D9.TIME_SCALE: Native 5m event plus frozen 12-bar (1h) resolution horizon.
